proposal.description: The clean-run counter holds at any count at or above clean_run_target, but the strike clear still waits for an exact match. So if the target is lowered below the running count, the counter freezes at a value that can never equal it.
proposal.reason: Suppose the host writes a CLEAN_RUN target below the clean count already reached while strikes are outstanding in S_RUN. The original counter keeps counting, wraps and then reaches the new target, so strike_level is cleared. The mutant holds the counter above the target, so strike_level is never cleared for the rest of that run.

proposal.description: A completed clean run sets the strike count back to one strike, treated wrongly as the base cool-down level, instead of clearing it to no strikes.
proposal.reason: After a fault-free run of clean_run_target cycles following a hiccup, strike_level reads 1 instead of 0. The next hiccup then gets the doubled cool-down index, and latch_assert trips one hiccup sooner than MAX_STRIKES allows.
